findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Software Engineering Intern @iFAST Global Hub AI" → 4 lines (7 words, 28px); "Research Assistant @Monash University Malaysia" → 3 lines (5 words, 28px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 2 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Nov 2025 — Feb 2026" above "Monash University"; "2023 — Present" above "Research Assistant @Monash University Ma"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.
Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.PhoneMockup-module__gVs4qq__stage → linear-gradient(160deg, color(srgb 0.960784 0.906274 0.876863), rgb(245, 245, 245))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 8 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.FeaturedWork-module__T9WFSa__preview → color(srgb 0.960784 0.415686 0.121569 / 0.2) 0px 30px 80px -20px | div.FeaturedWork-module__T9WFSa__preview → color(srgb 0.960784 0.415686 0.121569 / 0.2) 0px 30px 80px -20px | div.PhoneMockup-module__gVs4qq__phone → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 18px 40px -12px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).
Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "hands-on experience building modern soft" 3.7:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.7:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No visible button in the first screen.
findings.fix: Give the one primary action a real button in the first screen (a filled or solid-bordered control, 44px or taller), not only a link in the navigation.
Give every clip a poster frame: in the study of 100 Sites of the Day only 31% had one, and the blank or grey boxes before the clips played were recorded as faults (references/imagery.md §11).
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 40px (2.8vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The margins differ: 42px on the left, 66px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 1490px of nothing between: "Tech Stack"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.
